digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow gates and verdict schemas
propositions: The survived-LLM-step-failure tally scope must be activated in review-code gate dispatch alongside collect_contract_violations and drained into the coverage object already present in the code-review verdict

The survived-LLM-step-failure tally must be placed at coverage.llm_step_failures in completion_verdict (not as a top-level key) with coverage object created only when tally is non-empty, to maintain attestation safety and byte-identity on signed clean-run verdicts

Both code_review_verdict.schema.json and completion_verdict.schema.json must declare coverage.llm_step_failures with required fields [total, by_step] and minimum values of 1, mirroring the plan_review_verdict declaration
The completion_verdict drain must occur in completion_reconcile immediately before validate_structured to ensure the key appears only when step failures are recorded
Clean runs must not create empty coverage containers: review-code verdict omits llm_step_failures key when no failures, and completion verdict omits coverage key entirely when no failures
